code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), with mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. The findings suggest acute respiratory failure with possible underlying infection or bone marrow dysfunction. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
